independent_review.scope: Exact indexed measurement caller source only; no execution or product/performance acceptance.

limitations: Hash checks and Python AST parsing are source validation only. No caller/control import, build, service, benchmark or runtime test was performed by this reviewer.

Actual populated admission, completed producer/B18 receipts, final role binding, native/package maps, fresh noise/capacity receipts and long receipts must be evaluated by their existing execution checks; this review creates none of them.
The source review does not establish throughput, latency, correctness under real TLS load, resource recovery, historical-result reuse or completion of any 30-minute segment.
Execution remains with the existing finite owner and its exclusive reservation. This review does not authorize competing load or modify the prepared all-noise publication gate.

resolved_findings.finding: The short protocol reader imposes a 64 MiB result-file bound and is unsuitable as long-run admission.
resolved_findings.resolution: Long admission uses the original streaming metadata parser and original producer identity functions; the short path remains unchanged.

resolved_findings.finding: Selecting the whole scenarios object still loads its nested sparse histograms and can hit JsonStream.value's 4 MiB record bound.
resolved_findings.resolution: The reviewed admission excludes scenarios for long runs. The unchanged full verifier checks each client correctness flag, frozen oracle, request ledger, duration, service limits and release before credit.

resolved_findings.finding: A noise projection must not relabel a completed execution from another scene.
resolved_findings.resolution: The preserved ten-scene gate additionally requires role=before and scene_name(execution.group, execution.scene) to equal its publication key.

role_mapping.after_identity: Separate exact final binding tied to the immutable before admission; no candidate or actual runtime is accepted by this source review.
